for events 0x300, 0x340, 0x380 and 0x3c0 only: keeps the saved frame (trap_frame), opens the serial port (trap_serial_setup), prints "ADDRESS CHECKER TRAP" and the FPU, general, MAC, VBR/GBR/DBR, PR/PC/SR values from the frame (FPUL and FPSCR come out under each other's labels, the game's own slip: context_save_dispatch pushes FPUL and then FPSCR, so FPSCR is frame word 0x2a and FPUL 0x2b, and the text prints "FPUL: " with word 0x2a; the "FR0-7" / "FR8-15" rows, words 10-25, are the bank with FPSCR.FR = 1 and the "(B)" rows, words 26-41, the bank with FR = 0) and then 0x45 hardware registers (address and value, list trap_dump_regs), asks for the interrupt to be canceled, waits for RETURN, writes the code to 0xff000024 and closes the port; called by int_break_handler; named after its own string; checked against reference material (not in this repo)

SCIF: waits for a received byte and returns it; SCI: returns 13 (RETURN) when the port data bit (0xffe0001c bit 2) is set
when the SCIF was the port chosen (trap_serial_is_sci 0) resets the SCIF registers (0xffe80000-24) to their idle values; in either case stops the SCI module clock again (STBCR bit 0)
sends a zero-terminated string a byte at a time (trap_serial_send_byte)
sends a word as eight upper-case hex digits, most significant first
